name: dsh-bigger-choice
description: Enlarges the built-in composer model picker's popup (taller and wider) so one screen shows many more models. Client-only: it injects one stylesheet that overrides the host popup's box, which the host then measures and places as usual.

meta.title: 更大的模型选择框
meta.description: 把输入框右下角模型选择器的下拉框放大：最高 78vh、最宽 620px，一屏能直接看到十几个模型，不用再滚很久。
